title: One booking, start to rebooking
summary: Replay with simulated data, combining appointment reminders, the review requester and the repeat-customer tracker. A client books a cut and blow-dry at Studio Nine for Saturday at 10 through the salon's own booking link, and it lands in Saturday's calendar with no fee to anyone. On Friday evening they get a WhatsApp reminder. After the visit on Saturday they get the salon's Google review link. Six weeks later, with no new booking, the repeat-customer tracker sends a friendly nudge to book again.
